profile_text: With a focus on management and strategy development, this Düsseldorf-based consulting firm has experienced a 35.5% growth since its baseline, driven by its expertise in supporting various industries. As a specialist in strategic consulting, the company's services are in high demand, leading to an expansion of its workforce to 225 employees in 2024. Its success can be attributed to its ability to provide tailored solutions, earning it a categorization as a Scaler in the information and communication sector.
